buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process'),app=process.env.PARKFLOW_WEB_APPLICATION;if(!['customer','management'].includes(app))throw new Error('Set PARKFLOW_WEB_APPLICATION to customer or management');const result=cp.spawnSync('npm',['run','export:'+app+':web'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:process.platform==='win32'});if(result.error)throw result.error;if(result.status!==0)process.exit(result.status??1);fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('apps/'+app+'/dist','dist',{recursive:true});"
